Keyboard Shortcut Keys

General
alt + a Open Accessibility Menu
alt + q Hide Accessibility Menu
alt + k Open keyboard shortcut box
Landing Page
alt + l Go to Login Page
alt + r Go to Registration Page
alt + f Go to Forgot Password Page
alt + p Go to Profile
alt + s Go to Service Directory
alt + d Go to Dashboard
alt + t Go to Application Tracking Page
myGov - মাইগভ is an online one-stop platform for the citizens to access all the government G2C, G2B and G2G services. Bangladesh citizens can easily apply for services via multiple access points.
